1. (Currently Amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder; and a solvent, wherein the binder is a thermally conductive epoxy different from the glue used in You et al.

2. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface at a temperature above the evaporation point of the solvent.

3. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed by vaporization during application to the electronic component surface via heating.
